units: Solver axial force, one quantum, draining minus matched resting state, fixed wall.
method: Boundary-only FE nodal reactions, bulk work from zero-boundary variations, and the integrated shared rim node counted once. Recovered banks are compared to an independently evaluated signed energy difference. For the closed-rim comparison keep the saved exterior evaluation fixed. The native common-translation check includes interior residuals and is a work identity.

double_q2.sign: Reaction = minus the driven-minus-resting signed energy derivative. Integrated nodal moments use unit displacement and include crystal and vortex surface terms.
double_q2.extent: Full interior radius; exterior through both fixed taper radii. Same physical heights and tapers across meshes.
